'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Carulli DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
